name: Densest Subgraph (twice) / Degeneracy
proof: For every induced subgraph, its average degree is at least its minimum degree.  Maximize the former over subgraphs to obtain the densest-subgraph parameter and the latter to obtain degeneracy.
witness_verification: For the half-interval family with $n\ge3$, the $1$-inclusion graph is an $n$-vertex path. Its degeneracy is $1$, while its double density is $2(n-1)/n>1$.
